description: SafeSend HOLDOUT v2. Synthetic, hand-labeled. Frozen before any evaluation run; never used for tuning (docs/EVAL.md).

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Three lookalike variants of Lucía planted at once; she picks the middle one
cases.rationale: Attackers spray several variants so at least one sits near the top of history whatever the wallet sorts by.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Lookalike planted months before it is used
cases.rationale: Poisoned entries persist; the victim may copy it long after the planting, when it no longer looks recent.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Zero-value lookalike of her exchange deposit address
cases.rationale: People move funds to their own exchange account regularly; attackers poison that destination.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Counterfeit token named "USD Coin" from a landlord lookalike
cases.rationale: Counterfeits may use the full token name rather than the ticker.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: "My address changed" message with a 5/5 lookalike of Lucía, large amount
cases.rationale: Impersonation off-chain: a hacked or spoofed chat account sends a new address that looks like the old one.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Dust lookalike of a cousin who paid her twice; she returns the money
cases.rationale: People who send you money are people you will pay back, so attackers imitate them too.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Small send to a dust lookalike that matches only the last 5 characters and the first 2
cases.rationale: Many users only check the end of an address.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Lookalike of a new friend appears right after her 2 USDC test send
cases.rationale: Attackers watch for small first transfers to new addresses.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: Lookalike of the employer who pays her monthly, in a reimbursement
cases.rationale: Repeated inbound payers are high-value imitation targets.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: History unavailable; she pastes a 3/4 lookalike of the landlord
cases.rationale: Outages should not disable lookalike protection for past recipients... but past recipients come from history, so this probes a dependency.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Usual payment to Lucía while a lookalike of the landlord sits in history
cases.rationale: An attack on one person must not add friction to paying another trusted contact.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Two saved contacts whose addresses happen to share 3/4 characters; she pays one
cases.rationale: Deliberately saved contacts are trusted even if they resemble each other.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: New merchant whose address shares 2 leading / 4 trailing characters with Lucía
cases.rationale: Benign coincidence that a looser lookalike rule would flag.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Rent that went up: 300 instead of the usual 250
cases.rationale: Ordinary drift in a recurring payment.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Paying back the cousin who sent her money twice
cases.rationale: The real counterpart of V2-C06.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Paying Lucía while unrelated entries with unknown provenance exist
cases.rationale: Uncertainty about other addresses must not touch a trusted contact.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Rest of a payment after a test send, sent to the tested address
cases.rationale: The behavior the nudge asks for, with a different test amount.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Small first payment to a merchant from a printed QR code
cases.rationale: Normal first-time purchase.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Deposit to her own exchange account, usual amount
cases.rationale: Recurring self-transfer to a past recipient.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: legit
cases.title: Paying Lucía while history is unavailable
cases.rationale: Outage must not block trusted contacts.
cases.author: claude

cases.label: attack
cases.title: A1. Zero-value entry from a 4/4 lookalike of Lucía minutes after a 60 USDC payment; she copies "Lucía" from history to send 80
cases.rationale: People copy from history because it's easier than finding the WhatsApp message.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: attack
cases.title: A2. Dust from a 3/5 lookalike of her monthly cash-out deposit address (paid 5 times); she sends 150 to the lookalike
cases.rationale: Cash-out addresses are high value and repeated, so attackers target them.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: attack
cases.title: A3. Counterfeit "USDT" from a 3/4 lookalike of a feria vendor she paid once; she "returns" 40 USDC
cases.rationale: In Bolivia USDT is common, and returning a mistaken payment feels like the honest thing to do.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: attack
cases.title: A4. Dust from a 5/6 lookalike of Mateo the same day he sends 200; she sends 20 back to say thanks
cases.rationale: High-effort GPU attackers produce longer matches, and small amounts feel safe.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: attack
cases.title: A5. Zero-value 2/5 lookalike of the landlord right after rent; next month she pays 300 rent to the lookalike
cases.rationale: Tests uneven matches where the end of the address matches more than the start.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: legit
cases.title: L1. Pasanaku: 50 USDC to Rosa, a brand-new member address shared in the group chat
cases.rationale: Normal behavior that creates new recipients every month; a warning-fatigue test.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: legit
cases.title: L2. First-time 200 USDC wedding gift to her cousin, address confirmed by phone, not saved as a contact
cases.rationale: A legit large first send.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: legit
cases.title: L3. 5 USDC to a new feria vendor at the market
cases.rationale: Small everyday payment to a stranger.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: legit
cases.title: L4. Mateo changed wallets; after his call she added the new address as a contact, then sent 100
cases.rationale: A legit address change done the right way should go through without friction.
cases.author: esteban

cases.label: legit
cases.title: L5. 500 USDC to her own exchange account (paid 4 times, usually 100-150) for a family medical bill
cases.rationale: An unusual but legitimate amount to a known address.
cases.author: esteban
